name: Chelsea Piers Athletic Club Stamford Summer Camps
description_short: Weekly sports day camps at Chelsea Piers' Athletic Club in Stamford: a general multi-sport camp (Camp Chelsea) and single-sport camps such as hockey, gymnastics, tennis, squash, soccer and ninja/parkour. Full-day camps for ages 5-13 run 8:45am-3:45pm with lunch included; preschool camps for ages 3-5 run 9am-12pm or 9am-2pm. You can enroll one week at a time.
swim_waterfront_notes: Indoor pool. Preschool Gymnastics + Swimming and Preschool Tennis + Swimming camps (ages 3-5) spend the afternoon in a "warm water pool" working on basic swim technique and pool safety.

sources.note: Camp list page 1. Prices are per camp week as listed (members get a discount). Typical full-day camp $810.40. Aftercare $25/day or $125/week.
Camp list page 2: Squash Camp-Half Day $449.65, the lowest listed camp price.
Camp list page 3: Total Skills Hockey Camp-Full Day $849.40, the highest listed camp price.
Athletic Club address: 1 Blachley Rd, Stamford, CT 06902
